definitions.explanation: Describes food or drink that tastes good. One of the most common and useful adjectives for expressing positive opinions about food. Used in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {美味|おい}しい⟦レストラン→れすとらん：01048⟧⟦を→を：00422⟧⟦{知|し}っています→しる：00458⟧⟦か→か：09473⟧。
examples.english: Do you know a good restaurant?
examples.notes: 美味しい here means 'good' for food

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→ともだち：01478⟧⟦が→が：00051⟧⟦{作|つく}った→つくる：00481⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→りょうり：01523⟧⟦が→が：00051⟧⟦とても→とても：00593⟧{美味|おい}しくて、⟦びっくりしました→びっくり：03003⟧。
examples.english: The food my friend made was so delicious that I was surprised.
The fish at this restaurant is fresh and delicious. I like it so much that I want to come every week.

notes: The kanji {美味|おい}しい is sometimes used but the word is more commonly written in hiragana (おいしい). The opposite is ⟦{不味|まず}い→まずい：00733⟧ (mazui, bad-tasting). In casual speech, ⟦うまい→うまい：01279⟧ can also mean delicious, though it's more masculine/casual. Saying おいしい when eating is a polite way to compliment the cook.
